talents.name: Ghostly Strike

Increases the maximum number of targets you may have Sapped by 1, and increases your movement speed by 30% for 3 sec after Sapping a target.

talents.name: Heightened Senses

talents.summary: Resets cooldowns on other Rogue abilities

ranks: An instant strike that deals 100% weapon damage (145% if a Dagger is equipped) and causes the target to take 15% increased Rupture and Garrote damage from the Rogue. Lasts 15 sec. Awards 1 Combo Point.

talents.name: Death Mark
talents.cost: 25 Energy | 1 to 5 Combo Points | 20 yd range | Instant | 10 sec cooldown
talents.summary: Stores 12-60% of damage dealt per Combo Point, then deals it after 6 sec
ranks:
Finishing move that marks the target, storing a portion of the damage dealt by your attacks per Combo Point. Garrote and Rupture damage is stored at twice the rate. After 6 sec, the stored damage is dealt, up to a maximum increased by Attack Power and Critical Strike chance:
 1 point : 12% stored, 165 damage cap
 2 points: 24% stored, 267 damage cap
 3 points: 36% stored, 369 damage cap
 4 points: 48% stored, 471 damage cap
 5 points: 60% stored, 573 damage cap
